# Octicons (vendored fragment)

`package-dependents-16.svg` contains the unchanged inner path from GitHub's
[Octicons package-dependents icon](https://github.com/primer/octicons/blob/b5a1530f441e5b2f7b3c874fe669c5d0d1838d9c/icons/package-dependents-16.svg),
at commit `b5a1530f441e5b2f7b3c874fe669c5d0d1838d9c`.

Like the vendored Lucide fragments, it omits the outer SVG wrapper. Unlike
Lucide's 24-by-24 stroked shapes, this icon uses a **16-by-16 viewBox** and
**`fill="currentColor"`**, with no stroke. The frontend renders it at 14px
alongside package-dependent counts.

The source revision's [MIT license](LICENSE) is included. No icon package is
required at build time or runtime.
